svg.title: A flip purchase in six pictures
svg.desc: 1 An author lists a collection whose complete puzzles are locked. 2 A service buys the unlocking keys: payment is held while the seller delivers privately. 3 The buyer opens and checks the puzzles. 4 The buyer accepts the trade. 5 The payment goes to the author. 6 The service uses unlocked flips in a CAPTCHA. The same original balloon flip is used throughout; the hidden states are illustrated.
svg.text: Hidden pictures → working key → a useful puzzle
The reveal happens when the buyer opens the pictures—before accepting and paying the author.
Normal trade: keys stay private. Dispute fallback: a valid proof and public key release can settle payment.
